julesThoughtProcess: I chose a warm neon amber (#FFB020) to capture the grounded optimism requested. It evokes the glow of an old streetlamp or a forge—warm, resilient, and enduring in a high-tech world, providing a sense of comfort amidst the chrome.
storyPanel: The mag-lev train rattled above, shaking dust from the neon signs, but down here in the maintenance bay, the air was warm. An old salvage mech passed a mug of recycled coffee to the local dispatcher. Things broke down, parts were scarce, and the grid flickered, but no one was left to rust. Every sparked fuse and welded joint was a testament to the fact that, together, they could keep the city running. Another day, another patch, another shared sunrise.
